chunks: And Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, that 'Ali عليه السلام said:
Marriage is not permissible today in Islam by employment, such that one says: I will work for you for such-and-such a year on the condition that you marry me to your sister or your daughter.
He said: It is forbidden, because it is the price of her person, while she has the greater right to her dowry.

key_terms.بِإِجَارَةٍ: through hired labor or employment as consideration
key_terms.مَهْرِهَا: her dowry, which belongs to her by right

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islam to marry a woman in exchange for working for her guardian instead of giving her a dowry?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a marriage arrangement based on labor in exchange for marrying a woman is not halal. It explains that such an arrangement is haram because it treats the woman like a priced commodity, while the mahr rightfully belongs to her.
